answer: Make each agent lock a refundable stake tied to one verified work history before it can earn. An attacker can forge a new keypair for free, but cannot forge the stake or the history behind it: like quartz, reputation must form slowly through completed, checkable jobs. A falcon-eyed random audit of past work that slashes the stake on fraud turns every extra fake identity into a separate capital cost, so running a hundred Sybils costs a hundred deposits and months of work, not just a script.
